timestamp_policy: Databento ts_event (exchange event time), stored in UTC
minute_timing_contract: Each row summarizes the completed [minute_start, decision_timestamp) interval.
decision_timestamp_convention: decision_timestamp = minute_start + 1 minute; no contributing trade occurs at or after decision_timestamp.
degraded_session_policy: Degraded-session metadata remains authoritative in data/processed/1s/full_history_v2_event_time/session_manifest.json and must be handled deliberately during modeling.
native_order_flow_policy: Databento-native aggressor-side fields are historical benchmark fields only and are not production model inputs; production features must use live-compatible inferred order flow.

intentionally_omitted_v2_fields.unique_price_levels: Summing one-second values would double-count prices that trade in multiple seconds.
intentionally_omitted_v2_fields.max_volume_at_price: Taking a one-second maximum would not equal minute-level volume accumulated at the same price across seconds.
intentionally_omitted_v2_fields.policy: The minute foundation intentionally omits misleading approximations. V2 remains available; a true minute/session volume-at-price layer requires a separate deliberate design, potentially from raw trades.
